Settings
Character
SetupWalks through setup again with your current info filled in. Nothing is erased: only what you change is saved.
Auto-refreshPull your stats from the hiscores every 15 minutes.
Fill in Scroll from your statsDays you never logged by hand still show the XP the hiscores saw.
RuneLite data
Pages
TabsWhat Scroll, Achievements, Quest Hub, Coffer, Skills and Upgrades open on when you come back to them. The app itself always opens on Home.
NumbersHow skill XP is shown.
Look
LayoutHow Home's panes are arranged. Mosaic is uneven on purpose, and you can drag a pane by its header to move it. Orderly lines every edge up.
Command lineThe line at the top of every page takes commands: cd scroll, log mined for an hour, stats mining, -help for the list. Press / or the key under Esc to start typing. Off leaves it as a plain path.
Wide windowOn a wide monitor, the room beside and under a page fills with extra panes. The most useful come first, so more room only ever adds less essential ones. A pane's x hides it.
Theme
Scene artThe picture a theme carries. Focused shows a little of it, Illustrated shows more, Off shows none.
Artwork setTwo sets of pictures for the themes that have one. Quiet is a single object on a dark ground. Painted is the full scene.
Font

Headings and numbers throughout the app. Body text stays as it is.

The Terminal look sets its own type. These apply when the look is Classic.

How big everything is

Backup fileEverything: character, goals, Scroll, priorities, notes. Import merges with what is here.
Restore

The app snapshots your data daily and before anything risky. These live on this device. Use Backup for a copy you keep elsewhere.

🗺️ Roadmap

The long arc — the unlocks, gear, and milestones your account is headed toward. Level-gated things tick themselves from your stats; quests and drops you tick when they happen.

🔥 In reach

The locked things you're closest to — computed from your live stats.

💬 Wise Old Bud

The Wise Old Man's less accomplished cousin. Checks requirements against your live stats.
Library currently covers the big bosses, unlock quests, and common gear — it's growing. Try: can I do Barrows yet? · what do I need for Vorkath? · can I wear a whip?

📚 Skills

Every skill, where you are in it, and the wiki's guide for the stretch ahead. Tap a skill.

🎯 Goals & to-dos

Setting goals in OSRS matters — it gives you something to look forward to and keeps you moving in a productive direction. The world is a massive sandbox; move through it however you see fit.

Tip: after adding one, use + Step on it to break it into checkable steps.
